name: Polyplex (Thailand) Public Company Limited
summary: Polyplex (Thailand) Public Company Limited manufactures and distributes polyester films, metallized films, extrusion-coated films, cast polypropylene films, silicone-coated films, blown films, holographic films, and PET resins in Thailand and internationally. The company offers Sarafil, a range of plastic films, including BOPET, a polyester film; BOPP, a transparent bi-oriented polypropylene film; CPP films, a transparent cast polypropylene film; BLOWN PP for pressure sensitive applications; and sustainable films for carbon footprint reduction.
